item.description: The _expand_targets method is duplicated and incomplete. It has two separate implementations that don't properly handle group expansion and 'all' user resolution, causing test failures when expanding targets.
item.contract: Fix the _expand_targets method to properly expand group targets (#group) and 'all' targets into individual users by implementing proper API calls to Nextcloud's OCS endpoints and caching mechanisms. Ensure the method correctly handles both successful and failed expansions with appropriate fallback behaviors.

item.description: The NotifyResend class constructor has incorrect parameter handling. It's trying to use the 'from_addr' parameter which is not properly handled in the constructor, causing TypeError when constructing the object.
item.contract: Update the NotifyResend constructor to properly handle the 'from_addr' parameter by converting it to 'from_email' if provided, and ensure all parameters are correctly validated and assigned.

item.description: The Slack plugin has an issue with its URL parsing and validation logic. The URL parsing fails to correctly extract the required components from the URL, leading to assertion failures.
item.contract: Fix the URL parsing logic in the Slack plugin to properly extract and validate the required components (token, channel, etc.) from the URL, ensuring correct instantiation of the NotifySlack object.

item.description: The test is checking for a specific template configuration in the details() method, but the expected configuration is not found, likely due to missing or incorrect template configurations in the plugin classes.
item.contract: Ensure all plugins properly define their template configurations and that the details() method correctly reflects these configurations in the returned dictionary structure.

item.description: The SendGrid plugin has an issue with validation of email addresses. It's not properly validating the email addresses in the URL, leading to assertion failures when validating the URL structure.
item.contract: Fix the email address validation in the SendGrid plugin to properly validate email addresses in the URL and ensure the plugin correctly instantiates with valid email addresses.
